name: Warborn Grounds arena chain: the world's Vince McOrc sends out each round and the ring crowns the champion
contract: The Warborn Grounds arena chain (quests 254059-254063) is driven by Vince McOrc's gossip menu 932534: each option summons that round's challenger into the ring at (213.03, -3963.63, 37.104) and the challenger credits its quest on death, while the Orcamania Ring trigger (creature 9303637) crowns the final quest 254063 for any player who steps into the ring. #6740 reports that Lowfang never appears after taking the quest and #6755 that Vince offers no way to finish the last round. This case walks the chain as a real player does in world phase 1: the world's own Vince (991518), his assistant Gurgthock (255101) and the ring are spawned at their database spots, the player takes 254059 through the native accept request against that same world NPC, and only then stands in the ring and takes the round from Vince's menu. Killing Lowfang (254941) completes 254059, the second round stays locked until the first is handed in, and after the first four rounds are rewarded the player is crowned by stepping into the ring. The last round's menu has no summon option by design: its own text says to step into the ring.

Let the grid and the ring settle

and the first option is the one that sends Lowfang out
Send out Lowfang
DISCRIMINATING: Lowfang (254941) stands in the ring (#6740)
Defeat Lowfang the way a player does
his death completes the first round, 254059
Hand the first round in
Take the second round, 254060
Hand the second round in
Take the third round, 254061
Hand the third round in
Take the fourth round, 254062
Hand the fourth round in
Step back out of the ring, 25 yards away
Let the grid and the ring's line of sight settle
Take the last round, 254063 One Last Battle, out of the ring
CONTROL: the crown is not handed out while the champion stands outside the ring (#6755's real gate)
